An inline link to [Example](https://example.com "Example title").

A simple reference-style link: [ref][1].

[1]: https://ref.example.com "Ref title"

A shortcut reference: [shortcut] collapses to the matching definition.

[shortcut]: https://shortcut.example.com

An autolink <https://autolink.example.com> and an email <foo@bar.com>.

A bare URL like https://bare.example.com autolinks inside prose.
